status: Raw candidate audit; these are not final approved animations.
basis: All 14 source-only contacts and 10fps diagnostic GIF exports reviewed; actual 60Hz pose metrics.
stageIssue: The original large floor filled the shallow camera frustum. The capture script now has a finite floor, visible 1m reference grid and explicitly labelled review-only contact ellipse; no pose correction.

reviews.name: Idle_Fists
reviews.observation: Stable relaxed breathing; hands remain low instead of a combat guard.
reviews.recommendation: Keep as neutral idle; verify new fist mesh and explicit blendshape curves.

reviews.name: Walk_Fists
reviews.observation: Usable gait and arm swing, but 2.74m horizontal root travel is baked into the pose.
reviews.recommendation: Remove horizontal root travel and trim one full foot cycle; retain natural authored speed.

reviews.name: Run_Fists
reviews.observation: Usable running gait; 11.28m horizontal travel forces a very wide fixed camera.
reviews.recommendation: Remove horizontal root travel, trim one full cycle and verify loop position/velocity continuity.

reviews.name: Jump_Full
reviews.observation: Crouch, rise and landing are readable, but mesh floor penetration reaches about 8.1cm.
reviews.recommendation: Correct authored root/foot curves offline; preserve the source vertical jump trajectory.

reviews.name: Dash_Forward
reviews.observation: The source is a near-prone dive with about -3.84m depth travel rather than a clean side-view dash.
reviews.recommendation: Replace or substantially author a straight dash pose/recovery; preserve only useful anticipation.

reviews.name: Punch_Right_Jab
reviews.observation: The 0.2-0.5 second delivery is useful, but the body turns through back/front/opposite heading across the take.
reviews.recommendation: Remove global yaw and depth drift while preserving local shoulder/torso rotation; bake closed fists.

reviews.name: Potion_Drink
reviews.observation: Starts already tilted toward the mouth; repeats a sip rather than showing one preparation-to-recovery action.
reviews.recommendation: The 1.4-3.3 second region is closer to a complete single sip. Calibrate the bottle and remove repetition.

reviews.name: Item_Throw_Overhand
reviews.observation: Wind-up/release around 1.1-1.8 seconds is useful; the body rotates away and ends with changed heading.
reviews.recommendation: Stabilize global yaw and depth to the side-view plane; preserve the shoulder-driven release.

reviews.name: Staff_Cast_Forward
reviews.observation: The staff repeatedly twirls behind and across the head/body during 1.1-2.4 seconds.
reviews.recommendation: Correct the held axis and wrist path or author a clean forward cast; do not present this raw twirl as final.

reviews.name: Hit_Reaction
reviews.observation: A clear recoil/hunch and recovery, especially 0.2-1.5 seconds; mesh penetrates floor by about 8.5cm.
reviews.recommendation: Correct authored grounding and global heading, then retain natural recoil time.

reviews.name: Interact_Reach
reviews.observation: Forward reach and recovery read clearly, especially 0.2-2.4 seconds.
reviews.recommendation: Keep the reach; trim excess waiting and join neutral idle continuously.

reviews.name: Pickup_Low
reviews.observation: Starts crouched; the take mostly contains standing up from about 1.2-2.5 seconds.
reviews.recommendation: Build bend-down plus collection plus recovery offline, for example reversing then replaying the useful rising segment.

reviews.name: Sword_Horizontal_Slash
reviews.observation: Large body turns and multi-segment motion obscure a clean side-view slash.
reviews.recommendation: Root has chosen a new offline-authored slash instead of this raw candidate.

reviews.name: Sword_Aerial_Plunge
reviews.observation: The body dives horizontally and the blade points backward/sideways during the main action.
reviews.recommendation: Root has chosen a new offline-authored downward plunge instead of this raw candidate.
